item.title: Netanyahu Stands Firm Against Legal Pressure, Says Fried
item.description: In Israel, persistent efforts by administrative opponents to convict Prime Minister Netanyahu continue, according to reports.

item.title: Democratic Socialist Thomas Wins Oklahoma Senate Runoff
item.description: N'Kiyla Jasmine Thomas, a Democratic socialist, won Oklahoma's Democratic U.S. Senate runoff, defeating attorney Jim Priest to advance.

item.title: Trump-Backed Candidate Advances in Oklahoma Governor Race
item.description: Mike Mazzei, endorsed by Trump, defeated Gentner Drummond in Oklahoma's GOP runoff, pledging to eliminate the state income tax.
